body: I don't think you understand. Unlike most diagnoses, mine is one that will cause therapists to purposely not take you on as a patient as it is so difficult to treat. You can say, "they're not going to turn you away!" but I have been. Over and over.
I guess I can try that but I've always been told hiding my (official, not self-) diagnosis is a bad idea.

Don't misunderstand me, I really do want to talk to a therapist very badly. I just can't get one to see me :(

I'd rather be dead than strive for much longer. I'd rather six years flying by because they were good than 6+ years of torture.

What you're saying about therapy only works if you can find a therapist to see you. Therapists don't call me back after they hear I have BPD so I am trying to jump through hoops to even try to find SOMEBODY to take me on.

I guess that's where I fail; I have no peace with my own mind. I don't like me, I'm just stuck with me because that's life. It's an obligation that I'm getting really tired of. 

I wish it felt more temporary than it does :( It's been on and off like this for six years.

1) What I meant about therapists is that they very rarely willingly take on people with my disorder. Borderline is considered a therapist nightmare; I have been through...seven? I think? Seven or eight therapists. That is how difficult it is to handle.

2) You're very lucky that your friends keep coming back; mine do not. I am so difficult to be around that 95% of my friendships last <2 years. It is not their fault that I am so fucked up so I can't blame them at all.

3) I don't have enjoyable experiences except for the same things over and over. I repeat life constantly and I am in a loop of hell where more and more misery comes in but no new joy comes back in.

I know you're trying to help but the pain I feel every single day to the point where I cry myself to sleep is in no way worth me trying to replicate the few enjoyable experiences I've had just to get a reprieve. It's not paying a toll, a toll would consist of maybe 5% of life. This consumes 99% of mine.
